title: Phone cannot join the office Wi-Fi
symptom: Phone cannot connect to office Wi-Fi
user_description: My phone won't connect to the office Wi-Fi, but it works fine on my home network.

options.why: Erases everything and is far too drastic. The phone works on other networks, so it is not broken.

options.text: Make sure Wi-Fi is on and airplane mode is off, select the right network, re-enter the password, or forget the network and join again
options.why: Because home Wi-Fi works, the phone is fine. A wrong network, wrong password or stale saved connection are the likely causes.

options.text: Change the office Wi-Fi password for everyone
options.why: Disconnects the whole office to fix one phone. Out of proportion.

hints: What does it working at home tell you?
Could the saved network settings be stale or wrong?
real_world_tip: Forgetting the network and joining again clears bad saved settings and fixes many Wi-Fi tickets.
